# [PR #2076] Bump pytest --numprocesses from 4 to 8 across all platforms

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/2076
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-18T11:56:32Z

## 正文

## Summary
- Increased pytest `--numprocesses` from 4 to 8 for all test suites (CUDA, ROCm, Metal, and CuTeDSL examples) in the CI workflow.
- This better utilizes available CPU resources on CI runners to reduce overall test time.

## Changes
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: replaced all 5 occurrences of `--numprocesses=4` with `--numprocesses=8`
